title: Silver Tongue
subtitle: A place in the town
intro: You fell asleep over a textbook. You wake in a room that is not yours.
On the desk, a name: Kim Min-jun. Someone is knocking.

ui.name: What should they call you?
ui.draft: Type what you want to say…
ui.supportHint: Help is part of the game. You can change it at any time.
ui.prepIntro: A few days pass. You have a friend, a first wage, and a reason to stay. Ji-woo’s stall needs a dependable supply route. Two useful preparations remain before market morning.
ui.prepEstimate: Two useful preparations before morning. Reading and looking up words take no extra actions.
ui.waitExplanation: Advance the game calendar. No real-time wait or extra food/rent charge in this experiment.
ui.leaveHint: A conversation that changed something uses one action. Asking several questions does not use extra actions.
ui.offerHint: Check the terms before agreeing. Nothing has been paid or reserved yet.
ui.rivalHint: Match or beat the rival’s price and deliver today. Your resources must make the promise possible.
ui.lastCall: Last call: one action remains. Finish your current offer before departure.
ui.visitEstimate: One game day. Four actions before evening; reading and typing do not run down a timer.
ui.fulfillHint: Carry out your reserved agreement. The merchant honors it even after leaving.
ui.nextVisit: Wait for the next weekly visit
ui.returnHint: Your contacts, resources and story progress stay. The next visit is a game-calendar jump, not a week of real waiting.
ui.phraseHint: Insert an editable phrase. It is only spoken when you send it.
ui.oldTopic: Ask what happened to the chairs
ui.noScript: Understandable questions and offers work. If something is unclear, the merchant asks.
ui.unsaved: Saving is unavailable. Keep this tab open to continue.
ui.recovered: The saved experiment could not be read. It is kept as a backup; a fresh visit is ready.
ui.newConfirm: Start over? Your current experiment is kept as a backup.
ui.resultBody: You helped the town, negotiated a real agreement, and kept your promise. Min-jun still has questions about your English. The next town has questions for you.
ui.nextTownHint: First town complete. Traveling competitors join the story in the next experiment.
ui.assistRecord: You opened help during a negotiation. This offer is recorded as assisted, not as an unaided one.
ui.unknown: Ask about the need, price or deadline; then make an offer.

story.text: The book has Korean phrases with English in the margins. Its owner is learning your language. On the ID: Kim Min-jun. Remember the name; you do not need to memorize the whole page.

story.context: A woman in slippers peers through the doorway. She expected somebody else.

choices.reaction: She looks past you, then nods. You are not Min-jun. She taps the bill: “방세.” Rent. Somebody owes it.
She puts on her glasses, looks again, and laughs at her mistake. She taps the bill: “방세.” Rent. The name on it is Min-jun’s.

story.objective: Answer the woman at the door.

story.context: Keys turn in the door. The man from the ID freezes. Then he sees his book in your hand.

choices.reaction: He repeats your name. “My book. You… English?” His surprise turns into an idea.
“No name?” he asks in English, almost laughing. You point at yourself and tell him. Then he sees the English in his book.

story.context: “You teach English. I teach Korean,” Min-jun says, tapping the book and then himself.

choices.reaction: You shake on it. Neither of you has to know everything to be useful to the other.
“Slow. Good,” he says. He makes the same request about his English. This is a deal between friends.

story.context: Min-jun takes you downstairs. An old man moves his newspaper so you can sit.

choices.reaction: “Grandpa Park,” Min-jun whispers. Park smiles and points down the alley to the food stall. You have an introduction now.
Park pats the bench, pleased. Min-jun tells you his name and points out the food stall.

story.objective: Meet the neighbor who can help.

story.context: Ji-woo runs the stall alone. Min-jun introduces you. She sees you staring at the pan.

choices.reaction: She sets a roll down and waves away payment. Min-jun laughs: “My sister.” Your first useful sentence has got you a meal.
Ji-woo points to a rice roll, cuts it, and gives you a piece. Asking a question got you what you needed.

story.context: Later, you buy bread. The clerk hands back too little change. Park notices and holds up three fingers.

choices.reaction: The clerk puts his comic down, checks the price and returns the missing note. Knowing the amount changed the transaction.
He says the price slowly. Park shows the amount on your receipt. You ask for the missing change and get it back.

story.objective: Check the price and get your change.

story.context: Ji-woo has customers waiting. She asks you to help for one short shift.

choices.reaction: You carry over two rolls. When the rush ends, Ji-woo counts out your first wage. You helped, rather than just reciting a sentence.
She holds up two fingers; you check, then bring the order. The job is done, and she pays you the same wage.

story.context: At closing, a chair wobbles. Ji-woo needs supplies delivered reliably. Min-jun reads a notice: the weekly merchant will be here soon.

choices.reaction: Chairs, delivery, packing: different needs, one problem. The merchant can give the town a route for supplies. The clerk and copy-shop man want the same opportunity.
“Today,” Ji-woo says, showing the wobbling chair. Min-jun explains that reliability can matter as much as price.

story.objective: Find out what the town needs.

story.context: Min-jun helps you prepare a real offer. You can ask for help during the merchant conversation too.

choices.reaction: “Good. Ask what he needs first,” Min-jun says. The merchant’s stock may change; the useful thing is knowing how to ask and adapt.
He says it slowly and writes it in your Book. Looking up a phrase is part of keeping a conversation going.

story.objective: Try a phrase you can use with the merchant.

preparation.description: The clerk points out two sturdy chairs you can supply. Learn the item and condition.
preparation.result: You can supply two chairs. Min-jun adds 의자 (uija, chair) to your notes. This is an opportunity, not a stock guarantee.

preparation.description: Borrow his cart and discover why same-day delivery matters.
preparation.result: Park lends you a cart. Delivery is possible. The merchant’s rivals can deliver today; a promise for tomorrow will lose.

preparation.description: Get packing boxes and learn about another town competitor.
preparation.result: The copy-shop man gives you two boxes. 포장 (pojang) means packing. He is fast, but you can take a small urgent job.

scenarios.label: Chairs for the stall

text.text: 의자 두 개 필요해요. 오늘 주세요.
text.reading: Uija du gae piryohaeyo. Oneul juseyo.
text.meaning: I need two chairs. Please bring them today.

scenarios.changed: The clerk has filled the chair order. The merchant now needs somebody to move them. Your earlier question is still remembered.

scenarios.label: Get the chairs to the stall
scenarios.changed: The delivery is arranged. A new customer needs an order packed. The copy-shop man is making an offer.

scenarios.label: Pack the new order

text.text: 포장 두 개 필요해요. 오늘 할 수 있어요?
text.reading: Pojang du gae piryohaeyo. Oneul hal su isseoyo?
text.meaning: I need two packages packed. Can you do it today?

scenarios.changed: The urgent packing order has been filled. A new chair customer has arrived; this is a new order, not a canceled earlier deal.

price.meaning: I can pay up to {price} won. The rival is asking less.

responses.clarify: I need to say a price in won, and that I can do it today.
responses.negative: That sounded like a no. I should say clearly what I will do, or decline.
responses.unavailable: I do not have what this job needs. Check my supplies, prepare in town, or wait for the next job.

late.meaning: I need it today. The rival can do today; tomorrow will not work.

expensive.meaning: The rival can do it for {price} won today. Can you match that or offer less?

responses.cheap: That price will not cover my costs. I need to ask for more.
responses.quantity: That is not the number of items he asked for. I should check the quantity.

offer.meaning: Today, for {price} won. Is that your offer? Check the written terms below.

recall.text: 그건 끝났어요. 지금은 다른 일이 있어요.
recall.reading: Geugeon kkeunnasseoyo. Jigeumeun dareun iri isseoyo.
recall.meaning: That earlier order is settled. There is a different job now.

decline.meaning: That is all right. See you next time.

responses.lost: The merchant packs up at evening. Your progress stays. A weekly return or your reserved delivery is still available.
responses.success: Agreed. Your contract is reserved. Later market changes cannot cancel it. Complete the delivery to receive your earnings.
responses.ready: The merchant is in the square until evening. You can prepare in town, talk to him, or fulfill your agreement.
responses.preparation: The merchant visits tomorrow. Choose two useful preparations, or wait for morning when you are ready.
responses.fulfilled: The work is done and Ji-woo has her supplies. Margin {margin} won, bonus {bonus} won, total {total} won. The town has a dependable route now.
responses.ending: Min-jun is waiting at the stall.
responses.reservedUpdate: Your earlier agreement is reserved. This new opportunity is separate; the merchant still expects you to fulfill your promise.
responses.night: The alley quiets for the night. Morning comes: day {day}. Your next step is still waiting.

ending: Ji-woo sets a meal in front of you. “감사합니다,” she says this time. Thank you. The chairs, deliveries and orders are part of a route the town can depend on. Your conversation made it possible.
Min-jun opens his book. The English sentence he has written is simple: “My friend helped us.” You understand him before he explains. He asks you to tell him, in your new language, how you arrived.
The merchant leaves an invitation to the next town. Beyond this alley, traveling competitors have their own needs and advantages. For now, you have earned a place here—and a reason to continue.
